patterns.what_worked: One shared rule (compat api.get_spell_query) plus a per-class inline fallback, each gated on its own family; behavioural pins for the hunter helpers, a static pin against the banned `get_spell_query(...) or id` shape, and 10 mutation proofs on /tmp copies (separate WRATH/TBC gates proved independently).
patterns.what_was_hard: Removing the id re-probe changed the rank walk's verdict: 'absent' is now unreachable on TBC/WRATH, so truly-absent rank sets retry at the callers' throttles instead of latching a negative. Re-cut pins moved that finality contract to Era (where ids are the query) rather than weakening it. Several fixtures were id-only clients; they now model a real client's bidirectional spell data.
patterns.skill_gap: The existing suites gave no behavioural coverage for the shaman/druid WRATH token helpers, so the new suite carries exact source pins for those class gates in addition to the shared-helper behaviour.

escalation.recommendation: Add tests/spell_query_family_state.lua to tests/run.sh (orchestrator owns it). Operator in-client confirmation on Titanforge 3.80.2 for name-based state reads.
